object: "Resources for Human Development's Kailo Haven is a safe haven homeless shelter for individuals experiencing chronic homelessness and identified as suffering from some form of co-occuring disorders, including mental health and addiction challenges.This program provides:- Safe environment to live and sleep- Meals and snacks- Bathroom and laundry facilities- 12-step recovering meetings- Emotional Management Courses- Individualized meetings and support to obtain financial and medical benefits- Referral ServicesPlease call The Homeless Outreach Hotline at 215-225-8645."

subject: Code Blue (Project HOME)
object: "Project HOME provides an emergency shelter when it issues an emergency warning Code Blue. Code Blue is when the National Weather Service predicts wind chills of 20 degrees or lower or precipitation with temperatures below 32 degrees to preserve the lives of chronically homeless individuals.This program provides:- Short-term emergency shelterCity officials are urging the public to call Homeless Outreach at any time if they see someone who is homeless and sleeping on the street. Homeless outreach teams are available 24 hours a day, seven days a week."
